summary: Executed full smoke test suite against scripts/cli.js on Windows/Node.js 22.14.0.
Found and fixed 4 Blocker defects during execution.
B-001 (Blocker): scripts/cli.js sh() — spawnSync npm.cmd EINVAL on Node 22+ without shell:true. Fixed: added shell:IS_WIN default.
B-002 (Blocker): scripts/run-orchestrator.js — used orchestrate.cmd; Python venv installs .exe not .cmd. Fixed: use plain orchestrate cross-platform.
B-003 (Blocker): scripts/run-orchestrator.js — npm.cmd build step missing shell:isWindows. Fixed.
B-004 (Blocker): orchestrator-runner.md persona — 5 stale refs to removed setup-orchestrator.js. Fixed in source; personas regenerated + deployed.

comments.note: Node.js 22 changed behavior: spawnSync refuses to execute .cmd files without shell:true. This is a workspace-wide risk — any other script using spawnSync with npm.cmd without shell:true will silently fail on Node 22+. Recommend auditing all scripts/ for the pattern.

Full code review of scripts/cli.js (773 lines), scripts/run-orchestrator.js, personas/standalone/src/content/orchestrator-runner.md, README.md, AGENTS.md against plan acceptance criteria and QA-identified bug fixes.
AC#1-16 verified: all 16 plan acceptance criteria are met.

B-001 (shell:IS_WIN in sh()): Correct fix. Defaults shell to true on Windows, false elsewhere. Spread of opts allows override. Resolves Node.js 22+ EINVAL for .cmd executables. Pattern is consistent and safe.
B-002 (orchestrate not orchestrate.cmd): Correct fix. Python venv on Windows installs console scripts as .exe via PATHEXT, not .cmd. Comment in code explains rationale.
B-003 (shell:isWindows in npm build step of run-orchestrator.js): Correct fix. Symmetric with B-001.
B-004 (stale setup-orchestrator.js refs in orchestrator-runner.md): All 5 refs replaced with node scripts/cli.js setup --components orchestrator. Generated outputs regenerated.
setup-orchestrator.js is confirmed deleted — file_search returns no matches.

Minor acceptable deviations: (1) ANSI object named C instead of colors — functionally equivalent, more concise; (2) PIP constant absent — not needed because venvBin('pip') is used correctly.

Node.js 22+ shell:true pattern is a workspace-wide concern already flagged as a high-priority observation by QA (WP-006 implementation pipeline). No additional audit is required for this WP, but recommend a follow-up review of other scripts in a separate work package.
No rework required. Implementation is faithful to plan architecture, DRY, cross-platform, zero external dependencies.
